readDetails: TheSacramentoFree is a neighborhood gifting board — not a marketplace. Neighbors post what they are giving away, what they need, or what they would trade. No money changes hands.

Built for Sacramento because this is home. The website covers give, ask, map, events, and messages. The Android app adds Go Get: live map pickup, both people locked onto the trip until the item changes hands.
No ads, no data selling, no premium tier. If you use it and want it to stay online, the Support page is there.
